ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The Italy file is in the black drawer. ... The Chile file is in the white drawer. ... The Greece file is in the brown drawer. ... The file on the country whose capital is Athens is in a drawer of which colour?" -> answer org brown; the alt prompt asks about the Chile (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: white (answer of bridge alt's statement), black (answer at the same statement slot), grey (the alt prompt's own answer), brown (answer org kept).
